symptom: Dependabot alert ako/mxcli#21: "postcss-selector-parser (npm) Affected versions < 7.1.6, Patched version 7.1.6" (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf, quadratic parse of flat selectors such as .a.a.a...) in .claude/skills/packs/mendix-vega-charts/widget/package-lock.json
cause: The widget lock carried three vulnerable copies: 7.1.5 nested under postcss-modules-local-by-default and postcss-modules-scope, and 6.1.4 hoisted for cssnano-preset-default 5 (postcss-calc, postcss-merge-rules, postcss-minify-selectors, postcss-unique-selectors, stylehacks), all via @mendix/pluggable-widgets-tools 11.12.1 -> rollup-plugin-postcss 4.0.2. The cssnano 5 plugins declare ^6.x, and no 6.x release carries the fix.
insight: Two dead ends to skip. (1) `npm audit fix` cannot clear it and `--force` proposes @mendix/pluggable-widgets-tools 8.18.4, a three-major DOWNGRADE of the build toolchain; a dependabot PR cannot help either, because the 6.x copy has no patched version in its range. An npm `overrides` entry is the fix. (2) Forcing 7.x under cssnano 5's ^6 range looks risky, but 7.0.0's only breaking change is safe insertion during iteration. Measured rather than assumed: the widget built from the overridden lock is byte-identical to the baseline (all five dist files, cmp), and cssnano-preset-default over a corpus of merge, unique, calc, stylehacks, namespace and :is/:where selectors produced identical CSS under 6.1.4 and 7.1.6. The vulnerable shape is real in the old copy: a flat 20000-class selector took 468 ms on 6.1.4 and 54 ms on 7.1.6. Reachability is build-time only, on CSS from the pack itself, so this is hygiene, not an exploitable path. Neither govulncheck (Go only) nor bun audit on vscode-mdl sees this lock. To find which manifest a numbered alert means when the alerts API returns 403 to the session token, run `npm audit --package-lock-only` per lockfile; GitHub alerts cover every lockfile in the repo, not just the directories listed in .github/dependabot.yml.
